burning settlement environment, and starting-frame references.

toward the strong orange glow and smoke visible ahead.

No magical energy.

Maintain the established cinematic dark-fantasy atmosphere,
environment, costume, and weapon design.

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Natural human movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Clean cinematic cuts.

Dark evening forest illuminated by distant orange firelight.

English dialogue.

Natural lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

She reaches the final edge of the trees and slows down.

A burning settlement is revealed ahead.

People begin fleeing from the settlement toward the forest.

Several soldiers are retreating with them.

Riven remains near the road as they pass.

Behind her are dark pine trees,
smoke,
and the strong orange glow of the distant fire.

The Broken Sword remains carried with her.
